title: Green synthesis of graphene oxide–TiO2/Fe2O3/ZnO nanocomposites for photocatalytic degradation of petroleum refinery wastewater
description: SpeakForWater Episode 191: Green synthesis of graphene oxide–TiO2/Fe2O3/ZnO nanocomposites for photocatalytic degradation of petroleum refinery wastewater. A podcast conversation between Anna and Ehsan discussing the latest water resources research.
